rootCauses.finding: The static fallback hardcoded Three.js and addons to one jsDelivr import map. When that module graph was unavailable, main.js never executed, leaving the start button without a listener and preventing all runtime assets from loading.
Firebase marked unhashed /src JavaScript and CSS as one-year immutable content, allowing old UI and asset paths to remain mixed with a newer index.html.
The start button appeared actionable before the game-ready event, so a module-load failure looked like an unresponsive game rather than a boot failure.

fixes: Added src/bootstrap.js as the Vite entry and surfaced dynamic import failures.
Disabled the start button until dokkaebi:boot-ready and restored it only after initialization.
Added local Three.js vendor detection plus jsDelivr, unpkg and esm.sh recovery for static builds.
Changed service worker handling of code and title art to network-first exact-request caching.
Removed ignoreSearch cache matching for revised title assets.
Changed Firebase cache headers so /src, sw.js and static-bootstrap.js are never immutable.
Added a CI post-build check that rejects production bundles with external Three.js CDN references.
